facts.text: West Chester University froze tuition for in-state undergraduate students for the 2024-2025 academic year under PASSHE.

sources.title: Seventh Consecutive Year for No Tuition Increase at WCU
sources.quote: the Board of Governors for Pennsylvania's State System of Higher Education (PASSHE) voted unanimously to freeze tuition for in-state undergraduate students for the 2024-2025 academic year.
